retailChains.title: Retail Property Portfolios
retailChains.lead: Fewer site visits. Less wasted time across the portfolio.
retailChains.description: When property, design or contractor teams have to return to a location just to confirm existing conditions, the cost is bigger than the visit. Travel, scheduling and lost design time multiply across dozens or hundreds of properties. RESCAN creates a dependable record teams can refer back to when new site questions appear.

logisticsWarehouses.title: Logistics Warehouses
logisticsWarehouses.lead: Understand the whole warehouse before you redesign part of it.
logisticsWarehouses.description: Large logistics facilities are difficult to understand from fragmented drawings and isolated measurements. When existing conditions are missed, assumptions enter the design—and can later become clashes, redesign or additional investigation. RESCAN gives project teams a dependable view of the facility before those problems move downstream.

focus.headline: Focused on existing buildings.
focus.body: RESCAN is a Swedish company based in Växjö, focused on documenting existing buildings. Together with trusted specialist partners, we deliver as-built drawings and BIM models used in design, refurbishment, property management and property decisions.
focus.record: Since 2017, RESCAN has successfully delivered more than 250 projects, including multi-property programmes and logistics facilities of up to 96,000 m².
focus.aim: Our aim is straightforward: to give property and project teams accurate building information they can continue using after the site work is complete—reducing unnecessary verification, supporting smoother project work and helping teams make better-informed decisions.

corePrinciple.headline: The capture is only the starting point.
corePrinciple.body: If the teams that open the file still have to question basic existing conditions, important uncertainty remains. The goal is not simply to document the building. It is to create information people can continue using when decisions have to be made.

repeatability.headline: Consistency matters when the work repeats.
repeatability.body: Retail portfolios and repeat programmes need more than a collection of unrelated surveys. A repeatable approach gives different project teams a more consistent information base across multiple properties.

coverage.headline: Reduce the gaps that send teams back.
coverage.body: The more relevant existing conditions that are captured properly, the fewer basic questions require another physical investigation.

project0.title: Multi-Tenant Office — Jönköping
project0.description: Lease-ready floor plans for tenant adaptation.

detail.body: The property lacked accurate documentation required for upcoming tenant modifications. Without verified floor plans, redesign decisions carried rework and delay risk. RESCAN produced lease-ready 2D drawings to support confident planning and execution.

project1.title: Office & Warehouse — Växjö
project1.description: Verified floor plans for mixed office and warehouse facility.

detail.body: The combined office and warehouse facility lacked reliable drawings ahead of planned tenant adjustments. Inaccurate documentation increased the risk of coordination errors between administrative and operational areas. RESCAN delivered verified lease-ready floor plans to support controlled planning and minimize disruption.

project2.title: Apartment Building — Jönköping
project2.description: Facade renovation and area verification for permit approval.

detail.scope: Full 2D DWG floor plan documentation (sqm verified), facade elevation drawings for building permit submission
detail.body: The property required accurate documentation ahead of planned facade restoration and budget control. Existing drawings did not provide reliable area data or facade detail for permit submission. RESCAN delivered verified floor plans with exact sqm calculations and detailed facade drawings to support renovation planning, contract validation, and building approval.

project3.title: Multi-Tenant Office — Växjö
project3.description: Verified floor plans for planned indoor modifications.

detail.scope: Verified 2D DWG floor plans (sqm controlled), updated documentation for tenant adaptation
detail.body: Prior to planned interior updates, the building's existing drawings did not reflect current layouts. This created uncertainty in space allocation and cost estimation. RESCAN produced verified floor plans with controlled area measurements to provide a reliable foundation for redesign and budget planning.

detail.scope: Full-scale verified 2D DWG floor plan documentation, updated drawings reflecting current building conditions
detail.body: The headquarters had undergone multiple renovations over the years, but the drawings had never been consistently updated. This created uncertainty ahead of planned upgrades to installations and office areas. RESCAN delivered fully verified 2D DWG documentation reflecting the building's current condition, providing a reliable foundation for structured modernisation.

project5.title: Electrical Substation — Austria
project5.description: 3D BIM model for modernisation and capacity upgrade.

detail.scope: Coordinated 3D BIM model reflecting existing conditions, digital model prepared for upgrade and expansion planning
detail.body: Increasing electricity demand required the existing substation to be modernized and prepared for future expansion. However, reliable digital documentation of the facility was lacking. RESCAN delivered a coordinated 3D BIM model aligned to current conditions, providing a dependable foundation for upgrade planning and technical development.

project6.title: Mining Processing Facility — USA
project6.description: Coordinated BIM model for retrofit within active production.

detail.scope: Full-scale coordinated 3D BIM model reflecting existing conditions, digital model prepared for retrofit design and clash coordination
detail.body: Planned retrofit works within the processing facility demanded precise documentation of complex conveyor and structural systems. Inaccurate or incomplete records posed significant clash and downtime risk. RESCAN produced a coordinated 3D BIM model to support structured engineering and minimise disruption during upgrade.

project7.title: Electrical Substation II — Austria
project7.description: BIM model for infrastructure upgrade and equipment replacement.

detail.scope: Full-scale coordinated 3D BIM model of existing facility, digital model prepared for engineering and installation planning
detail.body: The substation required infrastructure upgrades and equipment replacement within an existing operational environment. Accurate spatial and structural documentation was necessary to ensure safe integration of new systems. RESCAN delivered a coordinated 3D BIM model reflecting actual site conditions, supporting controlled engineering and minimizing installation risk.

project8.title: Mining Processing Facility II — USA
project8.description: Detailed modelling of conveyor systems for retrofit coordination.

detail.scope: Full-scale coordinated 3D BIM model of processing systems, model prepared for retrofit design and installation coordination
detail.body: As part of the broader retrofit program, this section of the processing facility required detailed modelling of conveyor systems and structural elements. Accurate documentation was essential to integrate new equipment without disrupting ongoing operations. RESCAN delivered a coordinated 3D BIM model to support precise engineering and controlled implementation.

project9.title: Mining Processing Facility — Sweden
project9.description: Full-site point cloud for phased modernisation planning.

detail.scope: High-resolution registered point cloud of the full facility, structured dataset prepared for future modelling and engineering phases
detail.body: Prior to initiating phased upgrades, the facility required precise capture of structures and process equipment. Without dependable spatial data, retrofit planning carried significant uncertainty. RESCAN provided a full-site point cloud to serve as the foundation for future modelling and coordinated modernization works.

project10.title: Vehicle Inspection Facility — Jönköping
project10.description: Updated documentation for energy efficiency improvements.

detail.scope: Verified 2D DWG floor plan and facade documentation, updated drawings reflecting existing building conditions
detail.body: As part of long-term asset improvement, the property required updated documentation before implementing energy efficiency measures. Without accurate floor plans, upgrade planning carried unnecessary uncertainty. RESCAN provided controlled 2D digital documentation aligned with existing conditions to support informed investment decisions.

project11.title: Mixed-Use Property — Växjö
project11.description: Comprehensive documentation across retail, office, residential and parking.

detail.scope: Full-scale verified 2D DWG documentation, coordinated floor plans across retail, office, residential and parking areas, area-controlled drawings for renovation and contract management
detail.body: The mixed-use property included retail units, offices, residential apartments and an underground parking garage, creating significant spatial and contractual complexity. Prior to renovation, the contractor required precise and unified documentation across all tenant areas. RESCAN delivered comprehensive verified 2D documentation aligned to actual conditions, enabling controlled renovation planning and accurate contract management.

project12.title: Retail & Hotel Property — Växjö
project12.description: Verified drawings for renovation within active hotel and retail operations.

detail.scope: Verified 2D DWG floor plan documentation, digitized and structured drawings prepared for renovation and modernization planning
detail.body: The property combines ground-floor retail units with hotel operations across upper floors, creating significant coordination complexity. Prior to renovation and modernization initiatives, reliable and structured digital documentation was required. RESCAN delivered verified 2D drawings aligned to existing conditions, supporting controlled planning while accommodating ongoing commercial activity.

project13.title: Historic Church — Växjö
project13.description: High-detail 3D BIM model for restoration and fire safety.

detail.scope: Full-scale coordinated 3D BIM model, high-detail digital documentation prepared for restoration and fire safety planning
detail.body: Prior to planned restoration works and the installation of new fire safety systems, the church required comprehensive high-detail documentation. Due to the building's historical value, accurate recording of architectural elements was critical to protect heritage integrity during intervention. RESCAN delivered a full-scale 3D BIM model aligned to existing conditions, providing a controlled foundation for restoration planning and technical upgrades.

project14.title: Manufacturing Facility — Tingsryd
project14.description: 3D BIM model for modernisation and building permit preparation.

detail.scope: Coordinated 3D BIM model reflecting existing conditions, digital model prepared for modernization planning and building permit application
detail.body: Prior to modernization of the 14,000+ m² industrial facility, dependable documentation was required to support engineering decisions and building permit approval. Inaccurate or fragmented records increased the risk of delays and coordination errors. RESCAN produced a full-scale 3D BIM model to provide a controlled foundation for redevelopment and regulatory submission.

coreRisk.headline: The expensive part is having to go back.
coreRisk.body: A missing dimension or an unanswered site question looks minor at a single location. Across dozens or hundreds of them it means more travel, more scheduling, more coordination and more design time. One unnecessary return visit is a nuisance. Repeated across a portfolio, it becomes a cost.

coreRisk.headline: The larger and more complex the facility, the more expensive incomplete information becomes.
coreRisk.body: Large logistics warehouses can combine structure, services, equipment, mezzanines and years of alterations across large areas. Historic drawings and isolated measurements may only show part of the picture, and when important conditions are missing, design teams have to make assumptions.

consequenceChain.headline: Assumptions get more expensive as the project moves forward.
